unsupported_expected_archetypes.recommended_extension: Add REVENUE_CONCENTRATION_RISK DiagnosisType covering single-client or single-channel financial dependency where concentration is revenue-structural, not knowledge-based.

evidence_items.finding: owner reports anxiety when primary client shows any dissatisfaction
evidence_items.rationale: Owner anxiety tied to a single client signals market_position fragility. is_critical=true because this is a structural business-risk signal. Finding paraphrased from fixture to avoid outcome terms.

evidence_items.finding: no new business development activity is occurring
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of pipeline development is a critical market_position failure. is_critical=true; HIGH confidence.

evidence_items.finding: all staffing and investment decisions feel too risky to make
evidence_items.rationale: Decision paralysis driven by client concentration risk is a financial fragility signal. financial_health dimension.

evidence_items.finding: owner has not raised rates for fear of losing the primary client
evidence_items.rationale: Rate suppression due to client dependency is a market_position pricing power signal. HIGH confidence as owner confirms this directly.

evidence_items.finding: 74% of $380K annual revenue from a single month-to-month client; 4-year relationship; 3 secondary clients generating $99K; owner spends 35 hours/week on primary client; qualified pipeline value $18K
evidence_items.rationale: 74% revenue from one client on a month-to-month contract is the defining structural fact. market_position dimension. is_critical=true. Finding avoids must_identify terms ('revenue concentration', 'single client dependency', '74% from one client', 'existential fragility', 'no pipeline development').

evidence_items.finding: 74% of total revenue derives from a single client; business has no succession or diversification plan if that client departs
evidence_items.rationale: team_capability evidence item created to host revenueConcentrationPct canonical key mapping. Registry assigns revenueConcentrationPct to team_capability dimension. Derived from same facts as index 4 but framed as organizational dependency risk rather than market position fragility.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue appears stable and profitable at $380K
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue stability from a single client masks the fragility of the position.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): primary client relationship seems strong after 4 years
evidence_items.rationale: Long relationship duration is a misleading signal — month-to-month contract means the relationship provides no structural security.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): owner has deep expertise and strong client satisfaction
evidence_items.rationale: Expert delivery quality does not reduce the risk of single-client dependency.

validation_notes: SMB-005 is an archetype-gap case. Engine has no REVENUE_CONCENTRATION archetype. revenueConcentrationPct (74%) is mapped to evidence_item_index 5 (team_capability dimension) per registry requirement. A separate market_position evidence item (index 4) holds the same facts framed as pipeline fragility. pipelineValue mapped to index 4 (market_position). Must_identify terms avoided in all findings: 'revenue concentration', 'single client dependency', '74% from one client', 'existential fragility', 'no pipeline development'.
